definitions.explanation: A room or building where business or administrative work is conducted.

examples.japanese: {事務所|じむしょ}は3{階|がい}にあります。
examples.english: The office is on the third floor.

examples.japanese: {事務所|じむしょ}は{何時|なんじ}まで{開|あ}いていますか。
examples.english: Until what time is the office open?

examples.japanese: {事務所|じむしょ}で{働|はたら}いています。
{新|あたら}しい{事務所|じむしょ}は{駅|えき}から{近|ちか}くて{便利|べんり}です。
examples.english: The new office is close to the station and convenient.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}から{事務所|じむしょ}が{移転|いてん}するので、{住所|じゅうしょ}が{変|か}わります。
examples.english: The office is relocating next week, so the address will change.

notes:
{事務所|じむしょ} refers to an office—a physical workspace where business or administrative work is conducted.

COMMON TYPES:
- {弁護士|べんごし}{事務所|じむしょ}: law office
- {会計|かいけい}{事務所|じむしょ}: accounting office
- {設計|せっけい}{事務所|じむしょ}: design office
- {芸能|げいのう}{事務所|じむしょ}: talent agency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オフィス: office (loanword, often modern/corporate)
- {会社|かいしゃ}: company (the organization, not the place)
- {職場|しょくば}: workplace (general)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {事務所|じむしょ}に{勤|つと}める: to work at an office
- {事務所|じむしょ}を{開|ひら}く: to open an office
